stem.en: Which list gives the Mesopotamian powers in the order in which they came to the top?

feedback.en: Assur took over from Akkad around 2154 BCE, so the Akkadians came before the Assyrians.
The Sumerians came first. Akkad overshadowed them in 2334 BCE.
This is the order backwards. Hammurabi of Babylon came last of these, in 1792 BCE.

explanation.en: Sumerians first, Akkad from 2334 BCE, Assur from about 2154 BCE, and Babylon from 1900 BCE, with Hammurabi in 1792 BCE.

hints.en: The first writers came first. Hammurabi is the latest name you have met.
